caption: The drawing shows a single object, which is a lamp or possibly a type of oil lamp, resting on a square-based pedestal. The lamp has a transparent, bulbous glass reservoir at the top with a swirling pattern leading downward. At the top of the glass reservoir, there is a circular metallic fitting with two dark, cylindrical protrusions that may serve as burners or wick holders. The main body sits on a decorative stem composed of a series of rounded, stacked elements, leading down to a broad, ornate base. The base is quadrilateral with each face featuring engraved or embossed decorative motifs. The entire composition is monochromatic, rendered in shades of gray, giving the impression of a pencil or ink drawing. The drawing appears inside a rectangular border with an artist's signature, "G. Capelli," in the lower left corner. The overall color tone is off-white or sepia due to the aged paper. There is also a visible crease or crack running from the lower edge into the drawing near the base of the lamp.
title: Lamp
